purpose: confirm runtime display/resume and adapter duplicate behavior before implementation
steps: Use a disposable test parent session and no real worker.
Create a controlled sanitized completion fixture with deterministic event/idempotency key.
Send through the proposed backend adapter with safe summary plus canonical result pointer.
Observe parent session new user-role turn, assistant generation, persisted assistant message and normal stream.
Replay the same event and verify no duplicate turn/delivery.
Repeat with Desktop disconnected while backend remains online, then reconnect and inspect persisted session state.
Verify missing/closed parent fails closed and records terminal disposition.
Verify failed, cancelled and timed_out terminal statuses remain bounded and do not inject raw output.
prohibited_during_smoke: database mutation outside disposable test session
source_reason: source proves call path and normal-turn semantics; runtime Desktop reconnect/render behavior is the only remaining empirical confidence item
